premises.text: Field professionals doing site investigation still rely on pen, paper, and messy sketches that must be recreated on desktop
premises.evidence_span: he will need to recreate everything on the desktop computer when he's back to his office, which means he's doing the same thing two or even three times

premises.text: ArcSight converts freehand iPad sketching into precise geometry with real-time dimensions
premises.evidence_span: ArcSight converts his freehand input into perfect, precise geometry. It is the first and only algorithm that can do this in real time

premises.text: The algorithm recognizes combinations of lines and arcs and can predict tangency
premises.evidence_span: ArcSight can recognize any combinations of lines and arcs. It can even predict tangency

premises.text: Users can load blueprints and photos, sketch and measure on top of them, and keep field data organized in one place
premises.evidence_span: he can sketch and measure on top of it, like he's doing now

premises.text: A single digital file exports to desktop design software, eliminating recreate-from-scratch work
premises.evidence_span: he only has one digital file, which he can export to other desktop design software. This totally eliminates the need to recreate everything from scratch

premises.text: ArcSight Basic launches free on the App Store while Pro will add advanced features, cloud service, and coworker collaboration
premises.evidence_span: professionals can create and organize data, and also to collaborate and share with their coworkers

domains.name: Free Basic and Pro cloud collaboration

value.text: Field professionals capture organized site data once and save the time of recreating work on desktop
value.evidence_span: This totally eliminates the need to recreate everything from scratch. That is a huge time saver
